Rather than aiming for a conventional fuzz sound, it uses the relationship between gain, compression, and gating to produce everything from saturated, sustaining fuzz to abrupt, sputtering textures. Made in Hull, Québec, The Unpleasant Surprise has remained one of Fairfield Circuitry’s offers a wide range of sounds from a relatively simple control layout. The Volume control sets the overall output, and the Onset knob opens the gate and brings more of the fuzz and sustain into the sound. With Onset up, the fuzz is smooth, powerful, and unrestrained.
